subject.title: fix: preserve discovered context limits over static metadata

question: Should this shared context-cache helper treat every verified provider-discovery row as authoritative over bundled metadata, or should authority be explicitly limited to provider sources that declare that contract?
rationale: The documented Copilot path supports live-first behavior, but this generic helper changes compaction budgets for all discovery-capable providers rather than only Copilot.

options.title: Confirm shared live-first precedence
options.body: Confirm that verified discovery is authoritative for this helper, then rebase and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Introduce an explicit authority boundary
options.body: Limit the precedence change to discovery sources explicitly designated authoritative if other providers use advisory metadata.

recommendation.title: Confirm shared live-first precedence
recommendation.body: Confirm that verified discovery is authoritative for this helper, then rebase and merge after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Copilot catalog and metadata work makes this person the strongest available owner for the provider-authority decision.
